## 1. FORGE and Forecasting

**October 12 research update:** the five reviewed DRR directions below are planned work. The three reports require factual/accounting corrections and do not establish current code behavior or model performance. A stricter evidence-audit prompt has been delivered and TJ has launched a new research iteration; its result remains to be reviewed. The consolidated projection PRD/task document is still an unfinished draft. Prioritize the smallest useful native forecast-to-lineup path; speculative sophistication must not delay an independently qualified baseline. Implementation remains paused unless separately resumed.

- [ ] Extend next-game expectations to the next 10 and 20 scheduled team games from a fixed as-of origin. Sum the individual game means; independence is not required for that sum. Forecast appearances separately. Use dependence-aware simulation when needed for interval coverage, tail risk or joint outcomes, with postponements, trades and return assumptions explicit.

- [ ] Run a bounded goalie-start experiment against a simple recent-start-share baseline using equal-information chronological inputs, probability calibration/Brier score and accuracy. [Edgehalla's methodology](https://www.edgehalla.com/fantasy-hockey/tools/goalie-start-planner) reports 76.9% versus 65.1% accuracy and Brier 0.166 only on its March 2026 test. This is an experiment lead, not FORGE performance or an adoption threshold.

- [ ] Apply the DRR correction layer before adopting methods: verify current architecture from code; reject invented universal accuracy/error gates and arbitrary months-long timelines. NHL points are G + A, with PPP overlapping them; expected counts may be fractional. Handle goalie relief, empty-net attribution and ratio denominators correctly, including valid shutouts and no invented 30-minute win minimum. Fictional-hockey studies do not establish NHL forecast performance.

**Source constraints:** NST requests require at least 21 seconds of spacing, protected across retries and workers; this is not a response-time target below 21 seconds. AG, Cullen, DtZ and similar external/crowdsourced estimates may be retained only for isolated comparisons after native forecasts are frozen. Exclude them from platform inputs, priors, training targets, calibration/model-selection targets, blends, fallbacks, served forecasts and RSO/Start Chart recommendation values. FORGE3 native-bootstrap external-fantasy exclusion and calibration-provenance corrections are independently accepted locally, with 160 owner tests and 16 review checks. The local separation increment now also covers the apiHelpers latest-run guard (26 tests), three explicit-ID compatibility routes (36 review tests), and 13 consumer paths including native-baseline admission, shared revisions, Start Chart raw-run handling and FORGE fallback guards. Independent review accepted these bounded patches after the goalie-fallback P2 correction passed seven tests; no review findings remain within that reviewed scope. All changes remain local, not deployed. Final combined TypeScript/checkpoint evidence is pending. Historical calibration lineage, the SQL atomic guard, genuine issuance, provider acceptance and beta acceptance remain open; the reviewed patches do not establish full platform qualification.

October 12's diagnosis found 50 games for October 12–18, but an October 9 cache older than the 36-hour reader threshold; this left schedule coverage partial.
